seo_description: Exploreans is a small collection of places with character, where every stay is measured in what you do, discover and feel. Mara River Camp in the Maasai Mara and Watamu Beach Club & Villas on the Kenyan coast.

hero.beyond_alt: The Mara River at first light, elephants on the plains and a giraffe at the edge of the trees
hero.within_alt: Rippled white sand and shallow turquoise water at low tide on Mayungu Bay
hero.within_caption: Watamu Beach Club & Villas, Mayungu Bay

conviction.statement: Exploreans is a small collection of places with character, where every stay is measured in what you do, discover and feel.

beyond.label: Explore beyond
beyond.title: Out into the place
beyond.body: Its nature, its culture, its people. Guided on foot, on the water, at the table and in the village.
beyond.example: On foot at first light, reading the tracks with a Maasai guide.
beyond.alt: Three Maasai guides in red shukas in the long grass above the river at first light, one pointing ahead

within.label: Explore within
within.title: Into yourself
within.body: Stillness and movement. Sunset yoga as the sea turns gold, a quiet hour in the shade, a day that keeps its own pace.
within.example: An hour on the sandbank as the tide turns.
within.alt: A man standing barefoot on the sand at sunrise, eyes closed and arms open to the sea

pillars.intro: Three pillars define every Exploreans, and every place delivers all three.

items.name: Adventure
items.label: What you live
items.body: Guided experiences in and around every place, outward and inward, always led by qualified experts.
items.alt: Two guests in an open safari vehicle looking out across the plains

items.name: Awe
items.label: What you feel
items.body: The moment that stops you, then stays with you long after you leave: a river crossing, hippos surfacing below the bank, a sandbank rising from the sea.
items.alt: A pod of hippos resting in the brown water of the Mara River, seen from above

items.name: Authentic
items.label: What it is
items.body: Rooted in its place and its culture. True to itself.
items.alt: A Maasai guide in a red shuka standing beside a safari vehicle under a tree

places.headline: A river camp. A quiet bay. One name.
places.body: Exploreans belongs wherever there is something real to explore. Today, the name lives on a bend of the Mara River and on the Kenyan coast.

families.headline: Five ways to explore, in every place
families.closing: Every experience is led by someone who belongs to the place.

passport.label: Coming soon
passport.headline: The Exploreans Passport Collection
passport.body: Coming soon: a passport that is yours alone. Each place adds a page and each experience a stamp, signed by the guide who shared it with you. It becomes the story of your travels, held in your own hands.
passport.journal: And alongside it, a Travel Journal, for the moments only you can put into words.

moment.line: The day begins on foot, with the river still in mist.
moment.alt: The Mara River in soft morning light, framed by trees on both banks
